<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Polling vs Interrupt" id="poll_vs_irq"> <mxGraphModel dx="1697" dy="1164" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="920" pageHeight="720" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1" value="<b>Two ways to read a button</b>
polling (keep asking) vs interrupt (get told)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="500" x="210" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pollhdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=14;align=center;" value="🔁 <b>Polling</b> (2_button_poll.py)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="360" x="60" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=12;" value="check button.value()" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="180" x="150" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="== 0 ? (pressed)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="150" y="196" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=12;" value="print("Pressed!")" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="180" x="150" y="276" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="time.sleep(0.1) → repeat" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="180" x="150" y="330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pe1" edge="1" parent="1" source="p1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d79b00;" target="p2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pe2" edge="1" parent="1" source="p2" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;" target="p3" value="yes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pe3" edge="1" parent="1" source="p3" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d79b00;" target="p4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pe4" edge="1" parent="1" source="p4" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;rounded=1;" target="p1" value="loop"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="120" y="347" /> <mxPoint x="120" y="158" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pnote" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#8a6d00;" value="The CPU asks ~10×/second, even when nothing happens. And if the loop is busy elsewhere, a quick tap can slip through unnoticed." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="360" x="60" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="irqhdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;align=center;" value="⚡ <b>Interrupt (IRQ)</b> (3_button_irq.py / 4_button_led.py)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="360" x="500" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="i1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="button press
(the hardware notices)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="150" x="520" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="i2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="IRQ handler:
_pressed = True" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="150" x="520" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="i2note" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#b85450;" value="tiny! runs
instantly" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="70" x="670" y="196" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="i3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=12;" value="main loop
(free to do other work)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="150" x="710" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="i4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="if _pressed:
 do the real work" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="150" x="710" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ie1" edge="1" parent="1" source="i1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#82b366;" target="i2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ie2" edge="1" parent="1" source="i3" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" target="i4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ie3" edge="1" parent="1" source="i2" style="html=1;endArrow=block;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9673a6;" target="i4" value="reads the flag"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="inote" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#3a6b35;" value="The hardware fires the handler the instant the pin changes — even mid-loop. The handler just raises a flag; the loop does the real work when it gets to it." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="360" x="500" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="divider" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=none;strokeColor=#cccccc;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="460" y="80" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="460" y="430" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="banner" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" value="🚩 <b>The flag pattern (used everywhere in the real firmware):</b> keep the interrupt TINY — just set a flag. Do the real work (toggle the LED, send HTTP, update the LCD) back in the main loop. Never sleep, print, or make network calls inside an interrupt." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="800" x="60" y="460" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;" value="Polling is fine for one simple thing. Interrupts + the flag pattern let the board watch a button, a sensor, and a network all at once without missing anything." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="800" x="60" y="535" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: The CPU asks ~10×/second, even when nothing happens. And if the loop is busy elsewhere, a quick tap can slip through unnoticed.

div.div: The hardware fires the handler the instant the pin changes — even mid-loop. The handler just raises a flag; the loop does the real work when it gets to it.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 798px; height: 1px; padding-top: 480px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: 🚩 The flag pattern (used everywhere in the real firmware): keep the interrupt TINY — just set a flag. Do the real work (toggle the LED, send HTTP, update the LCD) back in the main loop. Never sleep, print, or make network calls inside an interrupt.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 798px; height: 1px; padding-top: 545px; margin-left: 1px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Polling is fine for one simple thing. Interrupts + the flag pattern let the board watch a button, a sensor, and a network all at once without missing anything.
